title: RoboLoc-G: Multisensor Localization Dataset from a Robotic Gantry System
modification: Derivative by Codex. Local recoding of anchors/session identifiers, within-clock intervals, double difference and comparison to the reported frame RTT. Attribution and changes should accompany reuse.

fields.trajectory: Trajectory path in the original release.
fields.source_row: One-based record ordinal within trajectory, in release order.
fields.anchor_local_id: Anchor identifier recoded by first appearance within each trajectory.
fields.session_local_id: Session surrogate identifier from the observed outer timestamp and anchor within each trajectory.
fields.t4_minus_t1_ps: Interval t4−t1 on one device, in picoseconds per data card.
fields.t3_minus_t2_ps: Interval t3−t2 on the other device, in picoseconds per data card.
fields.double_difference_ps: Difference of those two intervals in ps. Can be negative in the released observations.
fields.reported_frame_rtt_raw: Source frames.rtt integer, retaining zero. Data card and chipset SDK differ on its units; kept unconverted.
fields.reported_minus_derived_numeric: Numeric subtraction of the double difference from the original frame RTT, with no unit conversion.
fields.comparison_status: Categorical comparison: equal or reported_zero_negative_difference in this snapshot. Code also detects missing fields.

scope: Whole eight gtec-ftm.csv Wi-Fi fine-time-measurement files in archived UWB_FTM_IMU trajectories. Physical gantry robot and fixed anchors; Wi-Fi frame handshakes for ranging, not application-level age of information or inter-mobile-robot traffic. Other instruments/ground truth not downloaded here. Sampling units are table records, not individual successful round trips.

unit_evidence.disagreement: Data card labels frames.rtt (per-frame) ns. ESP-IDF v5.4 for ESP32-S2 lists wifi_ftm_report_entry_t.rtt in ps. The source card and SDK both label report-level rtt_est and rtt_raw as ns. Raw per-frame limits remain unlabeled by design. The dataset release's exact firmware build has not been established.

limitations: Session surrogate uses recorded grouping; it does not independently enumerate transmissions or missing frames.
Measurements concern a single gantry robot and fixed anchors, not multi-robot application-level message delay or age of information.
No assumption about the rounding or clipping mechanism for the two negative differences. Per-frame clock checks do not establish device synchronization.
